pages.title: Fastener Weight Calculator (Steel, by Size)
pages.meta_description: Fastener weight scales with shank diameter, length, material density, and quantity in this estimator. Use results for shipping and kit planning, then weigh samples to confirm.

pages.title: Tools | Calculators & Identifiers | BoltLab
pages.meta_description: BoltLab's interactive tools: bolt torque, fastener weight, screw and thread identification, drill bit, and unit conversion calculators for fasteners.

pages.title: Screw Size Conversion Chart (Metric ↔ Imperial)
pages.meta_description: Screw size conversion maps common metric diameters to closest imperial threads for stocking decisions. Use this chart-style converter, then open size pages for drills.

pages.title: Screw Identifier Tool (Head, Drive, Thread Match)
pages.meta_description: A screw identifier narrows candidates using head shape, drive recess, and thread family before you measure. Use it first, then run the thread.

pages.title: Tap Drill Size Chart & Calculator (Metric & UNC)
pages.meta_description: Tap drill size is the pilot hole diameter before you cut internal threads with a tap. Use this calculator for metric tap drills and inch pilots.

pages.title: Thread Identifier Tool (Diameter, Pitch, Match)
pages.meta_description: A thread identifier compares measured diameter and pitch (or TPI) to standard tables for likely metric or inch matches. Enter values here, then confirm with gauges when needed.

pages.title: Thread Pitch Chart & TPI Converter (mm ↔ TPI)
